name: build-number-sync
summary: Report a released build/version payload to one or more configured backend endpoints after publish.

patches.change: After a successful publish/upload, add an opt-in step that runs scripts/publish-build-number.mjs when BUILD_NUMBER_SYNC_URLS is configured. Pass BUILD_NUMBER_SYNC_URLS, BUILD_NUMBER_SYNC_PAYLOAD (JSON), BUILD_NUMBER_SYNC_KEY and optional BUILD_NUMBER_SYNC_KEY_HEADER via env. Keep credentials in _publish.yml and do not add triggers. See the README for the exact YAML.
